conversation_starters.title: Rare bird released back into wild after treatment at Minnesota rehab center
conversation_starters.summary: The bird spent the last few months healing at the rehab center after being found at the police station in Maple Grove, a suburb about 15 miles northwest of Minneapolis, with a broken clavicle.
questions: Did you see the rare bird that was released back into the wild after rehab?
